To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the prevention of the generation of acid mine water in dumps rich in pyrite uranium ore is possible by the construction of a specific soil cover.

(1) the generation of acid mine water can be prevented by construction of a rich in organics soil cover on the top of the dump and (2) the soil cover should be constructed in a manner that allows the water to infiltrate into it and to be purified by the natural processes of neutralization of the acidic drainage and oxidation of the reduced sulphur compounds.

the application of the specific soil cover on the dump surface was very efficient in the prevention of generation of acid mine waters containing uranium and its radioactive disintegration product and several toxic heavy elements.
